label: Actual coverage of support of a necessary concretum
term: actual coverage of support of a necessary concretum
definition: NecessarySupportActuallyCovered m w holds when, for every admitted world v and concrete candidates a and b, if b exists at every world accessible from w, a exists at v and a stands to b in the selected relation at v, then some concrete candidate c exists at w and stands to b in the selected relation at w. Ordinary meaning: a necessary concrete thing whose being is sustained by something anywhere is a sustained being, and so is sustained here too, possibly by something else. Orientation (not warrant): a flame burns only where something feeds it, though the fuel may differ from place to place. Counter-pattern it forbids: a necessary thing that stands on its own here but is sustained by another elsewhere, so that the sustaining is an optional extra. It does not require the supporter at w to be the one at v, to be necessary, or any edge to persist between worlds. v ranges over every carrier world, including worlds inaccessible from w, so this is not the modal claim 'if possibly supported then actually supported'; and the target b need not exist at v.
note: Analyst framework definition, attribution deferred; an open premise, not established. Weaker on concrete supporters and targets than STMT-NECESSARY-SUPPORT-IS-PRESENT (same supporter present and supporting at w) and than the package of actual reflexivity, STMT-NO-CONTINGENT-CONCRETE-SUPPORT and STMT-NO-NOVEL-NECESSARY-SUPPORT; both implications are verified in the NecessarySupportCoverage batch. Structural properties: it constrains only the cross-world presence of incoming support of necessary concreta, asserts nothing about transitivity, asymmetry or well-foundedness, and is satisfied vacuously by a relation that never targets a necessary concretum. Generalization from ordinary sustaining to the support of necessary beings is an explicit open bridge (see DEF-PRESENT-ESSE-SUPPORT: physical sustaining examples do not alone license the abstraction). Contingent grounding edges alone do not deny it (Control.rootedPair has world-varying edges and satisfies it); its formal denial is a necessary concretum with no actual concrete supporter that has one elsewhere; no independently motivated account accepting that denial is recorded, so no substantive objection to coverage is on file. No independent warrant for coverage is recorded either; its motivation is open. See docs/notes/modal-spine.md, join rows.
